## Marriott Vacations Worldwide Appoints Heena Patel as Chief Revenue Management Officer


**ORLANDO, Fla. – October 19, 2026 –** Marriott Vacations Worldwide (“MVW”) (NYSE: VAC) today announced the appointment of Heena Patel as Chief Revenue Management Officer, a newly created role and member of the company’s Executive Leadership Team. Patel will report to Mike Flaskey, President and Chief Operating Officer.


In this role, Patel will lead the company’s resort inventory optimization and revenue management strategy, connecting resort inventory, rental demand and digital commerce capabilities to strengthen inventory management across the company’s portfolio. Her leadership will bring greater focus to these capabilities, enhancing the company’s ability to optimize inventory while creating value for owners and serving rental demand.


“Heena brings deep experience in revenue management, inventory strategy and digital commerce, along with a strong track record of building capabilities and leading transformation,” said Flaskey. “As we continue to evolve our business, her leadership will help us take a more integrated approach to how we manage our resort inventory, creating value for our Owners, guests and shareholders.”


Patel brings more than 25 years of leadership experience spanning hospitality operations, revenue management, inventory strategy, digital commerce and business transformation. Most recently, she served as Senior Vice President, Rental Operations, Digital Marketing & Commerce at Travel + Leisure Co.


“I’m excited to join Marriott Vacations Worldwide and work with teams across the organization to build on the strength of its portfolio,” said Patel. “There is a tremendous opportunity to bring together inventory, demand and digital capabilities to enhance how we serve Owners, Members and guests and make the most of our available resort inventory.


**About Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation**


Marriott Vacations Worldwide Corporation is a leading global vacation company that offers vacation ownership, exchange, rental and resort and property management, along with related businesses, products, and services. The Company has 120 vacation ownership resorts and approximately 700,000 owner families in a diverse portfolio that includes some of the most iconic vacation ownership brands. The Company also operates an exchange network and membership programs comprised of more than 3,200 affiliated resorts in over 90 countries and territories, and provides management services to other resorts and lodging properties. As a leader and innovator in the vacation industry, the Company upholds the highest standards of excellence in serving its customers, investors and associates while maintaining exclusive, long-term relationships with Marriott International, Inc. and an affiliate of Hyatt Hotels Corporation for the development, sales and marketing of vacation ownership products and services. For more information, please visit[www.marriottvacationsworldwide.com](https://www.marriottvacationsworldwide.com/) .
